title: With GPT-5, Wrtn builds lifestyle AI for millions in Korea
summary: Wrtn scaled AI apps to 6.5M users in Korea with GPT-5, creating ‘Lifestyle AI’ that blends productivity, creativity, and learning—now expanding across East Asia.
body: Wrtn scaled AI apps to 6.5M users in Korea with GPT-5, creating ‘Lifestyle AI’ that blends productivity, creativity, and learning—now expanding across East Asia.
summaryZh: 韩国应用开发商Wrtn借助GPT-5的强大能力，成功将其生活方式AI应用推向数百万用户。该应用无缝融合了生产力、创意和学习功能，不仅在韩国市场取得显著规模，还开始进一步向整个东亚地区加速拓展。

aiReview.reasonZh: 韩国Wrtn利用GPT-5在亚洲大规模推广生活方式AI应用，展现了真实的大模型产业落地成效。
